counterfactual.change: Lowered mean inflow from 8 to 2 (one field) so net inflow no longer exceeds max outflow (demand 1 + valve max 6); failure disappears.

explanation: Mean inflow 8 exceeds max possible outflow (demand 1 + valve max 6 =7), so level must rise even with valve fully open (valve=1 at step 14).
